parsed.post: Huge improvement! 1.028351 achieved by reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04. The downward trend in LR (0.08 -> 0.06 -> 0.05 -> 0.04) is holding strong. Next: I'll probe 0.03 to see if we can squeeze even more out of this lower LR regime while keeping the batch size and warmup stable.
parsed.description: Further reducing learning rate to 0.03 to follow the observed downward trend.
